2607.09770.title: Verification of Adaptive Agentic Controllers through Finite Rule Revision
2607.09770.paper_summary: Industrial agentic AI systems increasingly exhibit a gap between prototype capability and production deployment. In particular, adaptive agents may generate plausible outputs while remaining difficult to verify under non-determinism, confidentiality constraints, limited context, and weak observability. This paper formulates a bounded verification protocol for adaptive agentic controllers represented by finite symbolic rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation. The central research question is: when an adaptive agentic controller is represented through finite rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation, which classes of controller failure can be detected, locally repaired, or rejected without relying on unrestricted human-in-the-loop judgment? The proposed framework treats the controller as a finite revisable object. Diagnostic failures are mapped to predefined rule-level edits, including rule addition, rule deletion, and priority revision. Repaired controllers are then evaluated on held-out simulation seeds or cloned initial states. Experiments in a stylized financially constrained inventory-control benchmark show three outcomes: resource-induced failures that remain non-repairable by one rule edit, partial repairs that are rejected because they violate thresholds or guardrails, and a local one-step repair of an order-volatility failure induced by removing a smoothing rule. The contribution is methodological and provides a simulation-compatible procedure for testing whether specific controller-level failures can be made observable, explainable, locally revisable, and empirically re-tested under controlled conditions.
2607.09770.paper_summary_zh: 工業代理 AI 系統越來越顯示出原型能力與生產部署之間的差距。特別是，自適應代理可能會生成似是而非的輸出，但在非確定性、保密限制、有限上下文和弱可觀察性下仍然難以驗證。本文為由有限符號規則、明確診斷謂詞、解釋日誌和保留再評估表示的自適應代理控制器制定了一個有限驗證協議。核心研究問題是：當自適應代理控制器通過有限規則、明確診斷謂詞、解釋日誌和保留再評估表示時，哪些類別的控制器故障可以被檢測、局部修復或拒絕，而不依賴於不受限制的人類判斷？所提出的框架將控制器視為一個有限的可修訂對象。診斷故障被映射到預定義的規則級編輯，包括規則添加、規則刪除和優先級修訂。然後，修復的控制器在保留的模擬種子或克隆初始狀態上進行評估。在一個風格化的財務約束庫存控制基準中進行的實驗顯示了三個結果：資源引起的故障無法通過一次規則編輯修復、部分修復因違反閾值或護欄而被拒絕，以及通過刪除平滑規則進行的訂單波動故障的局部一步修復。這一貢獻是方法論上的，並提供了一個與模擬相容的程序，用於測試特定控制器級故障是否可以在受控條件下變得可觀察、可解釋、局部可修訂且可經驗性再測試。
